name: No Devtools Warning
description: Removes the big "Hold Up!" warning that Discord prints in the developer console, so that the console is readable when someone is asked to look at a plugin's errors. As a side effect Discord stops hiding your token from the page while the tools are open, which also stops random logouts.

credits.name: Vendicated and contributors (Vencord), plugin NoDevtoolsWarning by Ven
